title: 第二十五章 问道台上，一剑惊仙
content_zh:
问道台，悬浮于东荒与中州交界处的一片虚空之中，由一整块不知名的灰白色巨石雕琢而成，历经万古岁月，台身上布满了刀痕剑孔，诉说着过往一场场惊天动地的对决。今日，这座古老的擂台周围，虚空之中，人影幢幢，气息如渊。

    东荒各大圣地、古老世家，中州轩辕帝族、战族，以及其他闻讯赶来的散修、隐世宗门代表，甚至一些平日里难得一见的老怪物，都纷纷显化身形，或以投影降临，或以秘宝观战，将这片虚空围得水泄不通。

    所有人的目光，都聚焦在问道台中央，那两个遥遥相对的年轻身影身上。

    一方，是轩辕破。

    他身材高大，穿着一件绣有五爪金龙的明黄色战袍，面容英俊，但眉宇间却带着一丝难以掩饰的倨傲和阴鸷。他负手而立，周身隐隐有龙吟凤鸣之声，各种颜色的神光交替闪烁，散发出多种不同体质的气息，显得既强大又诡异。他看向对面那道白衣身影，嘴角勾起一抹残忍的笑容，仿佛在看一只即将落入陷阱的猎物。

    另一方，自然是林墨。

    他一袭白衣，手持斩仙剑，身姿挺拔如松，神色平静如水。面对轩辕破那咄咄逼人的气势和台下无数道或审视、或好奇、或不怀好意的目光，他没有任何多余的表情，只有一种磐石般的沉稳和坚定。他体内的“无始皇道剑胎”缓缓旋转，散发出一种包容万物、又斩断一切的独特剑意，将他周身护持得滴水不漏。

    “林墨，没想到，你还真敢来。”轩辕破开口，声音中带着一丝戏谑，“我还以为，你会像个缩头乌龟一样，躲在天剑宗，不敢出来呢。”

    “废话少说。”林墨淡淡道，“今日，我只为践约而来。要战，便战。”

    “好！有胆色！”轩辕破眼中寒光一闪，“希望你的实力，能配得上你的狂妄！本皇子会让你知道，在东荒这种穷乡僻壤蹦跶的蚂蚱，永远无法理解，中州帝族的底蕴和强大！”

    他话音落下，不再废话，猛地向前踏出一步！

    轰！

    一股恐怖的气息，如同火山爆发般，从他体内冲天而起！他周身，各种颜色的神光疯狂交织、旋转，化作一道巨大的、仿佛能吞噬一切的光轮！光轮之中，隐隐有真龙、凤凰、麒麟、玄武等种种神兽虚影浮现，散发出令人心悸的威压！

    “吞天魔功——万灵噬体！”

    轩辕破低喝一声，那巨大的光轮骤然旋转起来，产生一股恐怖的吸力！这股吸力，并非针对肉身，而是直接作用于修士的本源和神魂！仿佛要将林墨体内的万道剑体本源、剑皇传承、甚至他的灵魂，都硬生生地从他体内剥离、吞噬！

    台下，一些修为稍弱的观战者，光是感受到那股吸力的余波，就感觉头晕目眩，体内灵力蠢蠢欲动，仿佛要被吸走一般，不由得骇然变色。

    “好邪门的功法！”

    “这就是轩辕帝族的底蕴吗？太可怕了！”

    “那个林墨，恐怕要糟了！”

    不少东荒本土的修士，都为林墨捏了一把汗。

    然而，面对这足以让普通道宫境修士瞬间失去抵抗能力的恐怖吸力，林墨却只是微微眯起了眼睛。

    他能感觉到，那股吸力中，确实蕴含着一种诡异的力量，想要剥离他的本源。但是，当这股力量接触到他的“无始皇道剑胎”时，却仿佛遇到了克星！

    “无始”剑意，斩断一切虚妄，破除一切束缚！“皇道”剑意，统御万法，镇压一切邪祟！两者融合而成的“无始皇道剑胎”，天生就对这种依靠外力、吞噬他人得来的驳杂力量，有着极强的克制作用！

    那股吸力，虽然强大，但根本无法撼动林墨的本源分毫！

    “这就是你的依仗？”林墨缓缓抬起手中的斩仙剑，指向轩辕破，“不过如此。”

    他话音落下，体内“无始皇道剑胎”猛地一震！

    一股凝练到极致、仿佛能斩断因果、破灭万法的剑意，自他体内迸发而出！他没有施展任何花哨的剑招，只是简简单单地，一剑斩出！

    这一剑，仿佛超越了空间和时间的限制，无视了那吞噬一切的光轮，直接斩向了轩辕破的本体！

    “什么？！”轩辕破脸色一变，他能感觉到，林墨这一剑，竟然完全不受他“吞天魔功”的影响！那凝练的剑意，带着一种让他本源都感到战栗的锋锐，直刺他的神魂核心！

    他不敢怠慢，连忙催动多种体质的力量，在身前凝聚出一层又一层的防御光罩！

    咔嚓！咔嚓！咔嚓！
content_en:
The platform is suspended in the void at the junction of Donghuang and Zhongzhou. It is carved from an unknown gray-white boulder. After thousands of years, the platform is covered with sword marks and holes, telling the story of earth-shattering duels in the past. Today, around this ancient arena, in the void, there are silhouettes of people, and the aura is like an abyss.

    The major holy places in the Eastern Wasteland, the ancient aristocratic families, the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan and the Zhan Clan in Zhongzhou, as well as other casual cultivators, representatives of hidden sects who came after hearing the news, and even some old monsters that were rarely seen in ordinary times, all appeared in their forms, either coming with projections or watching the battle with secret treasures, surrounding the void.

    Everyone's eyes were focused on the two young figures facing each other in the center of the platform.

    On one side is Xuanyuan Po.

    He was tall, wearing a bright yellow shirt embroidered with a five-clawed golden dragon. He had a handsome face, but there was a hint of arrogance and sinisterness in his eyebrows that was difficult to conceal. He stood with his hands behind his back, and there were faint sounds of dragons and phoenixes all around him. Various colors of divine light flashed alternately, exuding a variety of different physical auras, which seemed both powerful and strange. He looked at the figure in white opposite him, with a cruel smile on his lips, as if he was looking at a prey that was about to fall into a trap.

    On the other side, it was naturally Lin Mo.

    He was dressed in white, holding an immortal sword in his hand. His posture was as tall as a pine tree, and his expression was as calm as water. Facing Xuanyuan Po's aggressive momentum and the countless scrutinizing, curious, or malicious glances from the audience, he didn't have any superfluous expression, only a rock-like calmness and determination. The "Eternal Sword Embryo" in his body slowly rotated, exuding a unique sword intention that could accommodate all things and cut off everything, protecting his whole body without leaking.

    "Lin Mo, I didn't expect that you actually dared to come." Xuanyuan Po spoke with a hint of joking in his voice, "I thought you would be like a shrunken turtle, hiding in the Tianjian Sect and not daring to come out."

    "Stop talking nonsense." Lin Mo said calmly, "Today, I am only here to fulfill my promise. If you want to fight, then fight."

    "Okay! You have courage!" Xuanyuan Po's eyes flashed coldly, "I hope your strength can match your arrogance! This prince will let you know that a grasshopper crawling around in a remote place like Donghuang will never understand the foundation and power of the Zhongzhou Imperial Clan!"

    After he finished speaking, he stopped talking nonsense and took a step forward!

    boom!

    A terrifying aura, like a volcano erupting, soared into the sky from his body! All around him, the divine light of various colors intertwined and rotated crazily, turning into a huge light wheel that seemed to be able to swallow everything! In the light wheel, there are faint shadows of real dragons, phoenixes, unicorns, basalts and other mythical beasts, exuding a heart-stopping pressure!

    "The Heaven-Swallowing Demon Technique—The Devouring Body of All Souls!"

    Xuanyuan Po shouted, and the huge light wheel suddenly spun, creating a terrifying suction force! This suction force is not directed at the physical body, but directly acts on the monk's origin and soul! It was as if the origin of the Ten Thousand Dao Sword Body, the Sword King's inheritance, and even his soul in Lin Mo's body were to be stripped out of his body and swallowed!

    In the audience, some spectators with weaker cultivation levels felt dizzy just by feeling the aftermath of the suction force. The spiritual power in their bodies was about to move, as if they were about to be sucked away, and they couldn't help but change their colors in horror.

    "What an evil technique!"

    "Is this the foundation of the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan? It's too scary!"

    "That Lin Mo is probably going to be in trouble!"

    Many local monks in the Eastern Wasteland were worried about Lin Mo.

    However, Lin Mo only narrowed his eyes slightly in the face of this terrifying suction force that was enough to make ordinary Taoist palace monks instantly lose their ability to resist.

    He could feel that the suction indeed contained a strange power that wanted to strip him of his origins. However, when this power came into contact with his "Eternal Sword Embryo", it seemed that he had encountered a nemesis!

    "Beginningless" sword intention cuts off all illusions and breaks all constraints! The "Imperial Way" sword intention governs all laws and suppresses all evil spirits! The "Wushihuangdao Sword Embryo" formed by the fusion of the two is inherently capable of restraining this kind of mixed power that relies on external forces and devours others!

    Although that suction force was powerful, it could not shake Lin Mo's true nature at all!

    "Is this what you rely on?" Lin Mo slowly raised the Immortal Slayer Sword in his hand and pointed it at Xuanyuan Po, "That's all."

    As soon as he finished speaking, the "Sword Embryo of the Emperor's Dao" inside his body shook violently!

    A sword intent that was condensed to the extreme, as if it could cut off cause and effect and destroy all laws, burst out from his body! He didn't perform any fancy sword moves, he simply slashed out with one sword!

    This sword seemed to transcend the limitations of space and time, ignoring the all-devouring light wheel and slashing directly at Xuanyuan Po's body!

    "What?!" Xuanyuan Po's expression changed. He could feel that Lin Mo's sword was completely unaffected by his "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique"! That condensed sword intent, with a sharpness that made him tremble from the very beginning, pierced directly into the core of his soul!

    He did not dare to neglect, and quickly mobilized the power of various physiques to condense layer after layer of defensive light shields in front of him!

    Click! Click! Click!
title_en: Chapter 25: On the question platform, a sword shocks the immortal
